text:
maya_prod: dropped a new figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/usage-billing-rail-proposal. Two hot items: 1) right rail breakdown UX (compact stacked area vs tiny donut + legend) 2) invoice quick-preview inline vs separate modal. Quick eyes?
olivia_design: My read 0s: stacked area inline is denser and matches the row sparkline language. Donut works well as a focused flyout when user clicks "Breakdown". Suggestion: show denomination toggle (raw tokens vs k/M) because finance folks complained about visual noise on 6-digit numbers.
ravi_fe: Denomination toggle is easy. We already have a formatTokenCount util. Small gotcha: toggling will change column width and break virtualized row alignment unless we reserve max width. Recommend fixed-width monospaced column for totals.
nora_a11y: Accessibility notes: 1) Inline visuals must have accessible name: aria-label="Token trend for project X: 12.3k tokens, up 4%" 2) Donut must expose a textual list in DOM order before chart for SRs. 3) Avoid relying solely on color: add patterned borders or icons for legend items.
olivia_design: On microcopy: instead of "Tokens" use "Billable tokens" in headers to reduce confusion with local dev tokens. Also propose small hint copy: "Denominations can be toggled for readability" next to the toggle.
luca_research: In the last usability sessions people wanted a tiny invoice preview (one-line summary) on hover/keyboard focus: date, net total, click to expand. It reduced context switching. So inline quick-preview makes sense — but keep the full download behind a modal/export flow with audit controls.
ethan_pm: UX decision needed: primary invoice CTA placement. Options: A) Header-level primary action that adapts to scope, B) per-period inline quick-download. Proposal: header primary + per-row quick-preview (not full download). Full export in header only. Thoughts?
ravi_fe: Agree with Ethan. Implementation note: per-row quick-download triggers a lightweight preview API; full export hits the heavy batch job. Make sure preview endpoint is cached and returns small JSON.
nora_a11y: For previews, ensure keyboard users can open preview and dismiss with Esc, and that preview traps focus while open. Also announce loading state with polite live region.
olivia_design: On layout: when org-scope with many projects, stacked area scales better because donuts become many tiny slivers. For single project view, donut flyout is fine. I'll mock the flyout that replaces donut with an accessible table when opened.
maya_prod: sounds good. Also we need copy for export naming: ideas? "redwood-invoice-ORGNAME_YYYY-MM.pdf" or include scope id? Legal prefers not to expose internal IDs in filename. Suggest "redwood-invoice-ORGNAME_2025-06.pdf".
ethan_pm: Action items: Olivia to push two variants (inline stacked + donut flyout) by Tue, Ravi to spike fixed-width totals + preview API, Nora to draft a11y checklist and sample DOM, Luca to pull quotes about denomination preference, Maya to confirm export filename with legal. Deploy-bot: Reminder: feature behind flag "usage-ui-v2" on staging deploy 2025-06-03 02:00 UTC.
maya_prod: Can we aim to ship a small A/B for select accounts to measure which breakdown reduces support tickets? :bar_chart:
luca_research: I'll add a quick metric plan: click-to-preview rate, click-to-export rate, time-to-first-meaningful-action.
ravi_fe: noted. I'll also ensure animations are disabled via prefers-reduced-motion.
olivia_design: uploading mocks now. Will annotate where the pattern fills are for printing.
maya_prod: thanks all — catching up in design sync tomorrow. :raised_hands:
